Blacksmithing abilities

  • Armorsmith
    Allows a blacksmith to make special armors that are unavailable to the typical artisan blacksmith.
  • Master Axesmith
    Allows a blacksmith to make special axes that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.
  • Master Hammersmith
    Allows a blacksmith to make special maces and hammers that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.
  • Master Swordsmith
    Allows a blacksmith to make special Swords that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.
  • Weaponsmith
    Allows a blacksmith to make special weapons that are unavailable to the typical artisan blacksmith.

About these numbers

Colours. The client stores the skill at which each craft turns yellow and grey; green sits halfway, and a craft is orange until it turns yellow. That is exactly what the skill bar colours.

Learn skill. 66 of the 441 Blacksmithing recipes come from a trainer without a skill requirement in the client: what the trainer asks for lives on the server. The rest state the requirement the client has, on the recipe item or the skill line itself, and lock below it.

Season of Discovery. The client still carries 65 Blacksmithing recipes that Season of Discovery added, under a heading of that name. No merchant has been seen selling any of them, and the client cannot say what a trainer teaches, so they are left off this page.

Unnamed items. 3 recipes touch an item the client build gives no name for yet; those show the item id, and a product without a name is called after its recipe and marked as such.

Tooltips. Hovering a recipe, a reagent or the plan that teaches it shows Wowhead's tooltip for that item or spell, read live from their Forever database. Everything else comes from the client files.

Everything on this page is read from the World of Warcraft: Forever client, build 1.60.1.70862; the Classic Era comparison comes from build 1.15.9.69722. Reagent counts, thresholds and recipe items are the client's own, not a guide's.
